notes: every man of you is read as one substantive's multi-word rendering of the distributive אִישׁ, headed on man; the alternative of giving of you to the לכם suffix as a twice-realized pronoun under rule 18 was considered, but the ethical dative is already realized by you and the partitive completes the distributive noun.
אַחַת is unrepresented and the indefinite a belongs to אֶבֶן under rule 15; the competing reading is named in the unit note.
No article morphemes stand in the מספר שבטי בני ישראל chain, so each level takes a supplied the under rule 29.
